name: Etereo Kanai , Auberge Collection
positioning: Oceanfront Auberge Collection resort (officially Etereo, Auberge Collection) set above a mangrove forest in Kanai on the Riviera Maya
best_for: Couples and families wanting a beachfront resort with both an adults-only pool and a family pool
Food-minded travelers who like Mexican and Japanese-Mexican dining

facts.text: Etereo sits above a mangrove forest beside white sand beaches in Kanai, on the Riviera Maya.
Etereo is an oceanfront resort with direct access to a private white-sand beach overlooking the Caribbean Sea.
Accommodations have floor-to-ceiling windows and large terraces, many with private plunge pools.
Etereo welcomes families and has a Chavitos Kids Club.
Itzam is the main dining venue, serving elevated, modern Mexican cuisine.
El Changarro serves the daily local catch on the sand at lunch.
Etereo was designed by the New York studio Meyer Davis.
Ramps run throughout the property, including the walkways to the beach and the docks over the water.

highlights.text: Cena de la Abuela is a signature dinner honoring recipes the chefs grew up making in their grandmothers' kitchens.
The SANA spa has a cenote-inspired pool.
Studios feature carved wooden walls by the artist Manuel Felguerez.
Che Che pairs Japanese techniques with Mexican ingredients in an open-air setting.
Etereo has a dedicated biologist and a Green Team that looks after the beach and mangroves.

considerations.text: Playa del Carmen, the closest town, is about a 20 minute drive from Etereo.
Buyouts for weddings and company retreats are common at Etereo.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation for local exploration.
